feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. The candidate is the iteration 6 design (score 937.1, the best raced so far) with two small moves: sensor lead y from 0.06 to 0.07 m, and kd from 1.0 to 1.1. Sensor x positions, 16 mm footprints, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], kp 4.0, ki 0.05, base_speed 1.5, mass 0.40 and last_direction line loss are unchanged. The changes are valid: y = 0.07 is inside the 0.08 m limit and kd 1.1 is inside 0-10. Iteration 6 is the only design with every development track finishing 20/20, and its remaining loss is on slalom (0.65 line-loss events per run, rms_error 0.0111, max_error 0.0214, mean finish 2.92 s). Iteration 6 moved mass and sensor lead together, so the lead effect is not yet isolated, and this candidate changes lead and kd together, so the race result should be read as a pair. Iteration 4 showed that raising kp to 6 collapses oval and s-bend, so kp stays at 4.0. Iteration 2 showed that kp 4.5 also cost completions. Mass is already at its 0.40 kg floor. Plan the revision from the race telemetry as follows. If oval or s-bend completion falls below 100%, or steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35, revert to y = 0.06 and kd 1.0, the iteration 6 design. If slalom line_loss_events stay above about 0.5 while oscillation holds, try kd 1.2 before changing kp. If slalom finishes but completion_time stays near 2.9 s, test base_speed in steps of 0.1 (1.5 to 1.6), since iteration 0 showed the oval finishing near 1.9 s at 1.6.
requested_changes: If oval or s-bend completion drops below 100%, or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35, revert geometry.sensor_positions y to 0.06 and controller.kd to 1.0. Basis: iteration 6 kept both tracks at 20/20 with oscillation 0.20 to 0.33, and kd and lead changes are untested singly.

If slalom line_loss_events remain above about 0.5 with oscillation at or below 0.35, raise controller.kd in steps of 0.2 (1.1 to 1.2) before changing kp. Basis: iteration 4 showed kp 6 collapses oval and s-bend, and iteration 6 slalom had 0.65 line-loss events.

If slalom finishes but completion_time stays near 2.9 s, raise controller.base_speed in steps of 0.1 (1.5 to 1.6) while holding gains. Basis: iteration 6 slalom mean finish was 2.92 s against the 3.0 s limit, and iteration 0 showed the oval finishing near 1.9 s at 1.6.
